map.特征性损伤模式速查: Quick Reference for Characteristic Injury Patterns
map.经典干骺端骨折（Corner/桶柄征）: Classic metaphyseal lesion (corner / bucket handle sign)
map.牵拉扭转所致，几乎仅见于虐待: Caused by traction and twisting, seen almost exclusively in abuse
map.胸廓挤压所致，非意外伤标志性损伤: Caused by thoracic squeezing, a hallmark of non-accidental injury
map.需巨大暴力，日常跌倒难以造成: Requires enormous violence, hard to cause by an ordinary fall
map.多发性骨折（不同愈合期）: Multiple fractures at different healing stages
map.比跌伤骨折线更长、更复杂: Fracture lines longer and more complex than in falls
map.手脚浸入热水中，边界清晰锐利: Hands and feet dipped in hot water with sharp clear borders
map.臀部贴浴缸底，中央因接触面减压而免烫: Buttocks resting on the bottom of the bath with the contact area spared by relief
map.直径约8-10mm圆形全层烧伤: Circular full-thickness burns about 8 to 10mm in diameter
map.意外泼洒应有飞溅痕迹: Accidental pouring should leave splash marks
map.• 躯干可见抓握痕，但可无外部损伤: Grip marks may be seen on the trunk without other external injury
map.• 经典三联征：硬膜下出血+视网膜出血+脑水肿: The classic triad: subdural haemorrhage + retinal haemorrhage + cerebral oedema
map.• 颈椎过伸过屈损伤（无外部碰撞证据）: Cervical hyperextension and hyperflexion injury (without evidence of external impact)
map.• 压疮（长期卧床未翻身）: Pressure sores (prolonged bed rest without turning)
map.• 经济剥削（突然变更遗嘱/财产转移）: Financial exploitation (sudden change of will or transfer of assets)
map.• 心理变化（恐惧、沉默、回避特定照护者）: Psychological changes (fear, silence, avoidance of a particular carer)

map.依据损伤形态与分布规律识别虐待特征：干骺端螺旋/饼干样骨折、对称性肋骨骨折、长骨: Identify abuse features from injury morphology and distribution: metaphyseal spiral or cookie-cutter fractures, symmetrical rib fractures, multiple long-bone fractures (non-accidental forces), sharply bordered glove or sock-pattern immersion scalds, absence of defensive injuries and so on; judge in combination with age and developmental stage.
map.3 岁儿童（age=3）出现：股骨干螺旋骨折 1 处 + 对称性后肋骨折 3 处: A 3-year-old (age=3) shows one spiral fracture of the femoral shaft plus three symmetrical posterior rib fractures plus sharply bordered scalds on the backs of both hands (sock-pattern distribution). Three non-accidental features hold at once, so abuse risk is high. Combine with family background investigation and imaging follow-up rather than attributing it to a single accidental fall.
map.单次意外坠落会模拟出这些骨折吗？: Could a single accidental fall produce these fractures?
map.典型意外坠落多为单处颅骨/四肢骨干骨折且形态与着力一致；对称性多肋骨折、干骺端典: A typical accidental fall mostly causes a single skull or limb shaft fracture whose morphology matches the impact point. Symmetrical multiple rib fractures and typical metaphyseal lesions require repeated axial force and are hard to explain by a single fall, so abuse should be highly suspected.
map.烫伤边界整齐就一定是虐待吗？: Do sharply bordered burns always mean abuse?
map.边界整齐、呈套状/浸渍状且身体凸面均匀受累（如双手均匀红肿）更支持强制性浸入（非: Sharp borders with a sock or immersion pattern and uniform involvement of convex surfaces (such as uniform redness and swelling of both hands) support forced immersion and are non-accidental. Accidental poured scalds have more irregular borders related to a protective posture and must be judged with the history.
